_comment: Schema example for /api/validator.json. The real file is generated at runtime by scripts/node-info.sh against a live metalgo mainnet node and is gitignored. This example documents the expected shape and field types; values shown here are placeholders.

stake._note: self = operator self-stake. totalReceived = total delegated stake. max_weight = 5 × self (protocol rule).

uptime._note: network = median uptime as observed by external RPCs (peer-observed truth). self = the node's own response (always ~100% by protocol; reference only). source = 'external-median' when network is peer-observed; 'self-reported' when external RPC unavailable and self value is the fallback. Reward threshold: 80%.

delegationFee._note: Protocol minimum 2%; the operator's chosen rate may be higher.
